description: This Zenodo deposit contains simulation results generated with the AFTERLIFE wastewater-treatment optimisation framework at different iteration counts. The AFTERLIFE project publishes the results as supporting material for its software article on treatment and resource recovery in food industries. The article identifies an Excel workbook, and the resource landing page confirms the corresponding underlying-data package. Reuse is free under CC BY 4.0. The results describe a site-specific computational example associated with fish-processing wastewater, not observations from a monitored utility network. The deposit does not establish a calendar observation period or a broad geographic sample. It can help reproduce optimisation behaviour and compare implementation outputs when setting up the accompanying AFTERLIFE model. No directly related catalogue record was identified, and the numerical contents have not been downloaded or checked.
